articles.title: Is Trustpilot Group (LSE:TRST) Reasonable on Future Cash Flow?
articles.summary: Trustpilot Group has delivered a powerful 3 year run that has pushed the stock into a very different place from where it started. With the share price at £2.48 after a sharp move in recent months, a key issue for you is whether that price is supported by the cash the business is expected to generate. The stock has returned 142.0% over 3 years, which puts a lot of weight on whether the underlying cash flows can sustain that kind of re-rating. The company’s review platform model can translate...
